result.summary: The page looks generally polished, but a few minor issues were found: a truncated restaurant name, a suspicious '-100%' promo badge that implies a free item, and a missing visibility on the promo terms.

issues.description: Third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated and its card is cut off at the screen edge, which is expected in a horizontal carousel but the truncation may confuse users
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards are clearly horizontally scrollable (e.g., partial peek of next card) and use ellipsis consistently

issues.description: The '-100%' discount badge on the pizza listing implies a completely free item, which may be a data/styling error or misleading promo
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount value is correct; a -100% discount usually means €0 price, which is unrealistic for delivery

issues.description: White 'Order now' text on the green promo banner and small white text on delivery-time badges over images may have borderline contrast depending on underlying imagery
issues.suggestion: Ensure badges have sufficient overlay or solid background to maintain WCAG AA contrast

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, indicating horizontal scroll with no visual scroll affordance
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or partial next-chip peek to signal scrollability
